title: occ/{occ}/disposal payload
description: UPSERT payload of occ/{occ}/disposal: why and when a no-longer-owned copy left (Ross, 2026-09-27). Shown with a `former` status; kept, and hidden, under any other. Serialized, at most 13,444 bytes of UTF-8 as JSON.stringify writes it, under the Push cap MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES (65,536).

note.description: Free text, 1 to 2,000 Unicode code points; omit it rather than send an empty one.

counterparty.description: Who it went to or came from, 1 to 200 code points.

price.description: What it sold or traded for. A decimal string, never a JSON number (sync.proto rule 3).

amount.description: Non-negative decimal: up to 12 integer digits, no leading zero, up to 4 decimals, '.' as the separator.

currency.description: ISO 4217 alphabetic code, e.g. USD or JPY.

edited_at.description: When the user made the edit, in the device's local time with its offset (at most ±18:00). Display only; never compared, never restamped.

tz.description: The device's IANA time zone at edit time, e.g. America/Chicago. Display only.
